text: After the last Malabar Jew in Cochin dies, an antique seller loots his house of [a strange box with Jewish inscriptions|images|holy and occult objects], and that night an unseen force kills a worker in the shop. Ranjan Mathew, a nuclear waste specialist, is transferred to Kochi with his wife Priya, who [buys the box and opens it|trigger|bringing something home]. Strange events begin, and they learn it is a dybbuk box, holding a spirit that [possesses the unstable and the very young|threat|being taken over]: Abraham Ezra, [sealed inside by his father's black magic|origin|curses laid by others].
